title: A history of observations of a cat
description: Weight, water and other records, with the ability to fix a mistake and pick a period.

blocks.text: Spilled water can turn into a false record of drinking. A month later that error is still part of the chart.

quote.text: would be great if the app could save more than 30 days of data so I can track cat weight over a few months

blocks.text: Tell sensor readings apart from manual records. Let an episode be flagged as an error, a circumstance added, and selected data prepared for the appointment.
A long history is useful for a discussion with a specialist. There is no need to turn it into an automatic diagnosis.
